title: Vintage Catholic Wedding Ceremony with Ring Bearer, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1960s black-and-white square snapshot capturing a traditional Catholic wedding ceremony inside a church. The bride wears a classic lace gown and long veil, while a young ring bearer in a miniature tuxedo looks into the camera lens in the foreground. An altar server assists with the dress beside the groom and attendants.
